description.value:
You mark up to six creatures of your choosing within a 40-foot cube in range with a wasting affliction. Each must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer its effects for the duration.

An afflicted creature gains 1 slowed level, suffers a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saves, and loses the ability to take reactions. On its turn it may take either an action or a bonus action, never both, and regardless of its abilities or gear it can make no more than one melee or ranged attack per turn.

Should the creature try to cast a power with a 1-action casting time, roll a d20; on an 11 or better the power is delayed until its next turn, requiring its action to complete, or being lost entirely if it can't act then.

At the end of each of its turns, the afflicted creature may attempt another Constitution save, ending the effect on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 3
